title: Split with the anomaly holdout
summary: A person split that holds anomaly persons out by frozen lists and draws validation per variant.
does: The anomaly route's lists, applied as a split (planned). The holdout (data/splits/anomaly-holdout.json, frozen 2026-10-25) names 43 persons, T13, L6, four-lumbar and normal counts, that no checkpoint of the route's lineage may see, and deals the clean read VerSe L6 persons into 4 folds, each tested once. The validation draw (data/splits/anomaly-validation.json, frozen 2026-10-26: T13 1, L6 6, four-lumbar 1, both L6 and T13 1, normal 12) picks the fine-tune's checkpoint and is not drawn yet. No block applies these lists to a pipeline's data today.

inputs.name: data
inputs.what: Data with a person key and each person's variant, not split yet.

outputs.name: data
outputs.what: The same data with the holdout as test and a validation drawn per variant.

today.note: the lists serve the SPINEPS to FleXray anomaly route (docs/research/spineps-anomaly-route.md)
